mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a WPS and a WPQR?

acceptedAnswer.text: A WPQR (Welding Procedure Qualification Record — the ISO term, equivalent to an ASME PQR) documents the actual parameters used to weld a test coupon and the results of testing it. A WPS (Welding Procedure Specification) is the qualified, written procedure a welder follows in production, with its ranges supported by one or more WPQRs. In short: the WPQR proves it, the WPS instructs it. Elenchon links the two so every WPS is traceable to the WPQR evidence behind it.

mainEntity.name: Can Elenchon generate a WPS from WPQR test data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You define a preliminary WPS in the app, capture the actual WPQR parameters on the shop floor, import those real values back beside the procedure, and export a finalized WPS you write from them — with the official files uploaded or linked at any stage.

mainEntity.name: How does welder qualification and continuity (WPQ) tracking work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Welder Performance Qualification parameters are captured on the floor and reflected in the management app instantly. Elenchon logs 6-month welder continuity automatically from real floor entries and warns you before a qualification expires, so no welder works outside an approved range.

Welding qualification software manages the records that prove welds are made by qualified people to qualified procedures — Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Welding Procedure Qualification Records (WPQR, equivalent to an ASME PQR) and Welder Performance Qualifications (WPQ). Elenchon runs that whole workflow on-premise, so qualification data stays on hardware you own and audit evidence is always a click away.

mainEntity.name: Is my qualification data stored on-premise or in the cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: On-premise. Elenchon is a containerized appliance installed in your facility, so WPS, WPQR and WPQ records never touch a shared cloud server. Authorised staff and auditors can still connect remotely through Phrakton, a zero-trust, post-quantum-safe overlay, while the appliance opens no inbound ports to the public internet.
